name: objectLockCoveragePercentage
definition: Percentage of the account's private buckets that have Object Lock (WORM) enabled, rounded down.
population: the private buckets the backup storage account lists
evidenceRequiredForTrue: Not applicable: a percentage. A value is reported only when every private bucket's lock setting was readable.
